entities.summary: Vilhjálmur Þórmundur Vilhjálmsson is an Icelandic lawyer and politician who was mayor of Reykjavík 2006–2007 and was the chairman of the executive committee of the City Council of Reykjavik. He has been a member of Reykjavik's City Council since 1982.
